name: E52/E55

Network.Technology: Quad band (GSM / GPRS / EDGE):, GSM-850, GSM-900, GSM-1800 and GSM-1900, Dual band (UMTS / HSDPA):, UMTS-900 and UMTS-2100, UMTS-850 and UMTS-1900, UMTS-850 and UMTS-2100

Body.Other: Firmware Over-The-Air (FOTA) technology, Virtual Private Network

Platform.Operating system: S60 3rd Edition, Feature Pack 2 on Symbian OS 9.3

Cameras.Rear camera: Back-mounted; 3.2 megapixels (2048 × 1536 pixels) with fixed focus (Extended Depth of field) and flash. It supports VGA video recording up to 15fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wireless LAN (IEEE 802.11b/g), GPS, Assisted GPS, Bluetooth v2.0, microUSB, 3.5 mm Nokia AV connector
